docs.description: Confirmation dialog for actions needing explicit approval. 'default' for safe actions, 'danger' for destructive actions. Uses real Button component instances.

rules.reason: A dialog for an action that needs explicit approval, as the description says: its title, its description, and its own two lg Buttons, a secondary to cancel and a primary to confirm, the confirm Button danger where the intent is (Figma draws the intent as that Button's danger alone). Modal as Dialog is, over the Scrim, the focus in it and Escape cancelling; announced as an alert dialog, described by its description. MUI's Dialog on the web; in Flutter the surface is a widget, shown by showSolarDialog. Drawn in place where the caller asks (`inline`).

A confirmation dialog is 400 wide, as Figma draws it: Figma records its frame hugging, but everything in it fills its width, so there is nothing for it to hug, and Figma keeps the 400 it was drawn at. Hugging in code would make it as wide as its words run on one line; its words wrap within 400 instead.
SOLAR has no dialog width, one of the sizes with no variable, as Dialog's 480 and Split Dialog's 640. The page may be narrower, and the dialog then fits it.
